source_layer: Exact original native tokens, literal CSS declarations and original decoded/normalized origin evidence remain in the rich fork trace/envelope. That is distinct from model-input fidelity.

model_reductions.model_treatment: presence-set union; adjacent equal masks may merge
CSS_UNKNOWN presence, including literal font/font-weight/font-style; never translated to native emphasis or computed appearance
model_reductions.retained_elsewhere: complete literal style attributes and declarations, exact source tokens

model_reductions.model_treatment: JOINT_ORIGIN_ATTRIBUTION_UNKNOWN; no native tag assigned to normalized output space, including same-path joint groups
model_reductions.retained_elsewhere: all ordered origin evidence and literal mark chains

model_reductions.model_treatment: ZERO_EVENT plus presence-set at an owned normalized boundary; nonlocalized filter events anchored at group start as an explicit model choice
model_reductions.retained_elsewhere: all exact raw/decoded origins and normalization filter events

model_reductions.model_treatment: NORMALIZED_LAYOUT_SOURCE_UNKNOWN; only literal whitespace/pipe gaps permitted, never native-neutral or verified origin
model_reductions.retained_elsewhere: exact normalized gap ranges and hashes

model_reductions.model_treatment: external provenance only; not semantic model text
model_reductions.retained_elsewhere: bound descriptor, trace, envelope and source interval metadata

tokenizer_reduction: Existing pinned tokenizers may map source strings to unknown/subword tokens. Token-count feasibility is not semantic preservation.
text_roundtrip: Only escaped normalized literal text is exactly reversible from model strings; this is not full evidence or meaning roundtrip.
materiality_rule: Any observed material loss from omitted fields rejects the candidate. The experiment cannot clear an actual finding or alter the quality gate.
